description: Source code for handling WiFi mesh backhaul station configuration, including encoding and decoding JSON representations, translation between data models, and subdocument management in a web configuration context.

methods.name: init_mesh_backhaul_sta_subdoc
methods.description: Initializes the mesh backhaul station subdocument with predefined objects.

methods.name: access_check_mesh_backhaul_sta_subdoc
methods.description: Performs access check for the mesh backhaul station subdocument.

methods.name: translate_from_mesh_backhaul_sta_subdoc
methods.description: Translates data from internal representation to external data model (e.g., OVSDB or TR-181).

methods.name: translate_to_mesh_backhaul_sta_subdoc
methods.description: Translates data from external data model (e.g., OVSDB or TR-181) to internal representation.

methods.name: encode_mesh_backhaul_sta_subdoc
methods.description: Encodes internal data structures into JSON format for web configuration.

methods.name: decode_mesh_backhaul_sta_subdoc
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into internal data structures, validating and populating configuration.
